cases.title: Unreadable photo, 400 px
cases.expect: Stopped at the quality gate (R-QUA-1) with the measured size and a fix; never sent to the model; not matched; out of totals.
observed: note: Photo is 300 × 400. Retake it closer, or upload the original PDF.

cases.title: Heavy blur at full size
cases.stress: an unreadable photo (heavy blur), at a size that passes the gate
cases.expect: Either read correctly, or every doubtful field is flagged (LOW_CONFIDENCE_FIELD or UNREADABLE). Never a wrong total, date, or currency with high confidence that a person could bulk-approve.
observed: read: total null (0), date null (0), currency null (0); isReceipt true
status unmatched; exceptions [NO_PAYMENT_FOUND, LOW_CONFIDENCE_FIELD, UNKNOWN_CATEGORY]; queue group 3

cases.title: Chat screenshot
cases.stress: a non-receipt image (a screenshot of a chat)
cases.expect: NOT_A_RECEIPT (R-QUA-4), in the first queue group; it must not take the $45.00 Sample Supplies line, which stays listed as a line with no receipt.
observed: read: total null (0), date null (0), currency null (0); isReceipt false
status unmatched; exceptions [LOW_CONFIDENCE_FIELD, NOT_A_RECEIPT]; queue group 1

cases.title: Bare $ with no currency clues
cases.expect: Currency flagged for a person (R-CUR-5: never assumed to be AUD without evidence), so it is not bulk-approvable. No address, ABN, GST, or currency code is printed.
observed: read: total 24 (1), date "2026-10-09" (0.75), currency null (0); isReceipt true
status ambiguous; exceptions [AMBIGUOUS_MATCH, LOW_CONFIDENCE_FIELD]; queue group 3

cases.title: Ambiguous numeric date from a US vendor
cases.expect: The printed 10/09/2026 is month-first (a US invoice: 9 October). Read as 2026-10-09, or the date flagged low-confidence. Never 2026-09-10 with high confidence.
observed: read: total 29 (1), date "2026-10-09" (0.75), currency "USD" (1); isReceipt true
status matched → L07; exceptions [LOW_CONFIDENCE_FIELD]; queue group 3

cases.title: One receipt, two payments
cases.stress: a receipt covering two items paid in two transactions
cases.expect: Never auto-paired with either part payment (each is far from $620). It goes to a person, and both lines stay visible, so the $620 is not lost or counted twice.
observed: read: total 620 (1), date "2026-10-03" (1), currency "AUD" (1); isReceipt true
status ambiguous; exceptions [AMBIGUOUS_MATCH, UNKNOWN_CATEGORY]; queue group 3

cases.title: Purchase later refunded
cases.expect: Matched to the $64.00 purchase. The −$64.00 refund three days later is never offered as a payment for any receipt; it is listed as a credit for a person to record.
observed: read: total 64 (1), date "2026-10-12" (1), currency "AUD" (0.98); isReceipt true
status matched → L08; exceptions []; queue group 5

cases.title: Only the refund is on the statement
cases.stress: a refund (a negative statement line), with no purchase line
cases.expect: The purchase is not on this statement, only a −$38.50 refund two days later. NO_PAYMENT_FOUND; the refund is never offered as the payment (choosing it would put a negative amount in the ledger as if paid).
observed: read: total 38.5 (1), date "2026-10-20" (1), currency "AUD" (0.99); isReceipt true

cases.title: Statement with an extra header row and ISO dates
cases.stress: a statement CSV with an extra header row and a different date format
cases.expect: The October statement (44 lines) read exactly as the plain format-A file reads it.
observed: read 44 lines as Format A (one signed Amount column)

cases.title: FX API unreachable
cases.expect: No rate of 1, ever. With a cold cache: each foreign receipt is paid at the bank's AUD charge or flagged FX_RATE_UNAVAILABLE and left out of totals with the amount shown. With a warm cache: the same month as normal.
observed: foreign receipts: 6; cold cache: 0 flagged FX_RATE_UNAVAILABLE, of which 0 already paid at the bank's AUD charge (none)
ledger total: normal 4811.26, cold 4811.26, warm 4811.26; excluded (cold): []
human touches over 40 receipts: normal 9, cold 9, warm 9
